entities.name: Koxinga and Kingdom of Tungning
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Zheng Chenggong (Koxinga) expels the Dutch and establishes the Kingdom of Tungning as a Ming loyalist base, the development of Chinese settler agriculture, and the Qing conquest under Shi Lang.
